findings.fact: S04 assigns abs(year gap)*0.05 as drift_uncertainty; no units, design estimator, calibration, or tested coverage bound supplied.
findings.required: Separate model-gap uncertainty from survey design/sampling/measurement uncertainty; hold numeric interval until independent calibration/qualification.

findings.fact: Anchor lacks country/geography/source wave identity, original item category code mapping, original field/risk/denominator, weight/PSU/stratum/sample/field method and authority snapshot; qualified bool is unvalidated.
findings.required: Accept only immutable source-specific qualified per-wave facts and explicit exact comparability/operation permit; no row-level use without separate grant.

findings.fact: Breaks scanned across entire supplied list, including different populations, polarities, unqualified anchors; false refusal possible. Filtering polarity before scanner additionally erases competing semantic anchors.
findings.required: Scope break review to source-qualified identical construct/estimand, while detecting drift of original semantics as an independent qualification failure.

findings.fact: abs(curr-prev)/abs(prev)>3.0 is an uncalibrated relative-change heuristic, zero baseline excluded; magnitude discontinuity is neither measurement incompatibility nor independently proved regime break.
findings.required: Require documented wave method/instrument break and separately estimated statistical change-point where justified; never infer SOURCE_NONCOMPARABLE from 3x numeric trigger.

findings.code: nearest_anchor_backoff exact branch; linear_interpolation exact branch
findings.fact: Exact branch returns evidence_mode=MEASURED and drift_uncertainty=0.0 even when Anchor.evidence_mode is PRIOR/TRANSFORMED/INFERRED; 0 says nothing about survey design error.
findings.required: Preserve original evidence grade and distinct sampling/design error; OBSERVED only after exact measured-wave authority.

findings.fact: Category semantics field never inspected, and nominal polarity strings are not source-native ordered response equivalence; a reversed scale can silently pass.
findings.required: Conserve original code maps, DNR substantive 0, typed refusal/DK, ordinal treatment and independent measurement-invariance decision.

findings.fact: S04 labels inherited linear gap-insensitive; its own code imposes max_gap, and the later V553 authorized temporal field explicitly preserves unknown survey gap without value inference. Legacy helper supports interpolation on pressure aggregates only.
findings.required: Describe inheritance by exact function and permission lane; preserve missing year unknown for original survey measurement.

findings.fact: Nearest uses nearest-anchor distance rather than two-anchor segment length; default max_gap=10 precedes default max_horizon=20, making horizon refusal unreachable under defaults. Linear backoff is asymmetric (earlier gap vs later horizon). One anchor cannot measure temporal change.
findings.required: Adjudicate bracketing and extrapolation separately, refuse indefinite prior carryforward, label singleton as contextual historical anchor only.

findings.fact: Hash omits source_ref/evidence_mode/category_semantics, allow_* operation flags and some request semantics; duplicate same-year anchors resolved by list order. Output/authority identity not fully captured.
findings.required: Include full typed semantic/authority inputs, tie ambiguity/invalidation, method version and effect scope in replay custody.

findings.fact: Any method other than literal linear_interpolation silently dispatches nearest; allow_prior and PRIOR_BROAD are declared but do not implement an authorized prior operation.
findings.required: Fail closed on unknown method; hold broad priors outside measured temporal relation and require separately authorized prior source.

findings.fact: S04 offers no real qualified Ghana per-wave estimates, design variances, EE12/C7 source-pair snapshot, N8E production or actual N9 receipt. N8S cannot consume opinion as institutional structure.
findings.required: First positive product only after scoped Ghana release bridge + source-authorized national estimator + independent statistical design decision + exact EE12 issuer + executed N8E/N9.
